title: ServiceChannelStatusField - Data API
description: Represents the values that you use to indicate completed and in-progress work item status for the status field in the Status-Based Capacity routing model. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

ServiceChannelId.description: The ID of the service channel.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Type.description: For the field that you use to track work status, specifies whether the values are for completed or in-progress work.

Value.description: Specifies the values that you use to indicate completed and in-progress work status. Valid values are Completed, InProgress, and Paused.

special_access_rules: To access this object, Omni-Channel and Status-Based Capacity Model must be enabled.
